about.title: My Journey
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer shipping production web, mobile, ERP and business applications — backed by a CCNA networking foundation and hands-on Python network automation.
about.story1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in Nouakchott, Mauritania. I ship software across the whole stack — SOMAP RH, an HR and payroll platform in production for a national fuel-station network; a land-portfolio management platform backed by 641 automated tests; a mobile app published on the App Store and Google Play; six custom Dolibarr ERP modules in production; and AutoNetConfig — a Python + Netmiko + Flask toolkit for SSH-driven network automation. Laravel, React, Next.js, Flutter, Supabase and TypeScript for products; PHP, MySQL and Dolibarr for enterprise ERP; CCNA networking on EVE-NG when the wire matters.
about.story2: At MCS Consulting (since Dec 2025) I design and deliver client systems end to end. SOMAP RH takes station staff from a GPS-verified clock-in at the pump to the payslip and the company account it is paid from — Laravel 13 + React/TypeScript, money handled in locked, idempotent transactions, 425 automated tests in CI. For CAMEC, the national medical procurement agency, I built a Dolibarr module that replaces their Excel tracking of international imports with a 15-step workflow, Incoterms, document checklists and KPIs. Alongside: a production and manufacturing ERP module, APOSB (POS and commerce management) and OMDHD, a trilingual AR/FR/EN institutional website. On my own time I led the development of Traiteurs, a Flutter + Supabase catering platform with Bankily, Masrivi and Sedad mobile-money rails, and co-built AutoNetConfig during my Moov Mauritel internship.
about.story3: REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Row-Level Security, Docker, Linux, Git — those are the basics. The differentiator is the breadth: real systems in production, real enterprise ERP delivery, and CCNA-grade reasoning about the network beneath — sharpened by my internship at A2 Holding, where software development and ISP network infrastructure meet. I'm open to full-stack, backend and network-automation opportunities where the whole stack, screen to wire, needs someone who can hold it together.

projects.responsibilities: Architected and developed the complete solution

projects.items.title: SOMAP RH
projects.items.description: HR and payroll platform in production for SOMAP, a Mauritanian network of fuel stations, gas depots and agencies. GPS-geofenced clock-in decided on the server (Haversine), automatic absence detection, leave and salary-advance approval circuits, monthly payroll with itemised deductions, company cash and bank accounts with an immutable ledger, and a report explorer with Excel export plus a daily presence report sent on WhatsApp. Money is handled as decimals inside locked, idempotent transactions, with a policy on every route — 425 automated tests and Playwright journeys run in CI.

projects.items.title: Patrimoine Foncier
projects.items.description: Land-portfolio management platform covering parcels, acquisitions with instalment payments, multi-parcel investment projects, expenses, mortgages and guarantees, and sales through to the realised financial result. Executive dashboard with 12-month trends and alerts, and 8 filterable report families exported to Excel and PDF. Domain-driven Laravel architecture (actions, policies and presenters per domain), 5-role access control, a full audit trail and no financial or legal record ever hard-deleted — covered by 641 automated tests in CI.

projects.items.title: CAMEC Import Tracking
projects.items.description: Dolibarr module for CAMEC, Mauritania's central purchasing agency for medicines and medical equipment, replacing its Excel tracking of international supplier orders. Each purchase order becomes a dossier with one or more shipments moving through 15 configurable steps — computed status and delays, an immutable history of date revisions, Incoterms 2020 obligations, ISO 6346 container validation, a document checklist per shipment, supplier and forwarder follow-ups, and the agency's 6 KPIs on an action-oriented dashboard. Delivered with a security review, performance measured on 5,000 dossiers, user and admin guides and an acceptance-test kit.

projects.items.title: Traiteurs App
projects.items.description: Flutter + Supabase catering platform live on the App Store and Google Play, connecting clients, caterers and delivery drivers in real time. Lead developer in a small team (about 60% of 1,500 commits): wallet and credit codes with QR scanning, GPS driver tracking, delivery broadcast to nearby drivers, Mauritanian mobile-money rails (Bankily, Masrivi, Sedad), scheduled jobs on GitHub Actions, and a React + TypeScript operations console with a live driver map, commissions and OTP lookup. Backend on Supabase Auth, Postgres (PL/pgSQL), Storage, Realtime and Row-Level Security.

projects.items.title: APOSB
projects.items.description: Professional POS and commerce management system for boutiques, supermarkets and small businesses. Covers sales, purchases, stock management, invoices, partial payments, user roles and permissions, and MRU-based reporting dashboards (daily sales, customer dues, product performance, inventory and cashier activity). Delivered a premium business UI with realistic Mauritanian demo data and full Docker deployment.

projects.items.title: Fabrication ERP
projects.items.description: Production and manufacturing module for Dolibarr: raw-material and packaging purchases, production cycles with weighted average cost per warehouse, reception and delivery notes, direct, credit and raw-material sales, purchase and sales situations exported to PDF and CSV, an expenses journal and payroll with employee debts. Arabic PDF documents, MRU currency, dated SQL migrations, and server-side guards against double submission and stock/invoice inconsistencies.

projects.items.title: AutoNetConfig
projects.items.description: Python + Netmiko + Flask toolkit co-built during the Moov Mauritel internship. Automates SSH device configuration across Cisco-class equipment with Netmiko, scans hosts/ports and maps topologies with Nmap, and serves a real-time visualisation layer over Flask. Designed, built and validated on EVE-NG labs alongside GNS3 and Packet Tracer.

projects.items.title: OxCoreX
projects.items.description: Mobile-first crypto trading and investment platform on Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions), Supabase and Tailwind CSS v4 — an Arabic RTL user app and an English desktop admin panel. TRC20 USDT deposits, withdrawals protected by a transaction password, KYC verification, a referral system with signup and deposit rewards, and notifications, all on Supabase Auth, Postgres, Row-Level Security and role-based access.

projects.items.title: OMDHD
projects.items.description: Official website for a Mauritanian NGO focused on human rights and social development. Built 15+ pages covering news, reports, intervention areas, donation, volunteer and contact flows. Implemented a native trilingual experience in Arabic, French and English with full RTL support, Framer Motion animations, responsive layouts and a content architecture ready for CMS integration.

projects.items.title: Sadara Media
projects.items.description: Arabic-first RTL news platform built on Next.js with server-side rendering for SEO. Delivered an editorial RTL interface inspired by the Sadara visual identity, a custom CMS for article drafting, publishing workflow, media uploads and category management, a rich homepage and a complete back office — polished across mobile, tablet and desktop.

projects.items.title: GestionParc
projects.items.description: Fleet management module for Dolibarr covering vehicles, equipment and bases, maintenance with attachments, fuel tracking with searchable selectors and PDF reports, ambulance (SAMU) refuelling with intervention counts, and an internal fuel-station module linked to the fuel records. CSRF-protected actions, with deployment and user guides.

projects.items.title: MCS Consulting
projects.items.description: Official corporate website for MCS Consulting, a firm specialized in financial consulting and ERP solutions. Delivered a high-performance, responsive digital presence that strengthens the firm's brand identity and serves as a primary lead generation tool for enterprise clients.
